acct.title: Compromised account runbook
steps: Revoke the account's active sessions.
Remove any MFA device or token the user didn't add, or disable the account until the user is verified.
Block the attacker's IP, server, or lookalike domain.
Reset the password once the attacker is out.
Review everything the account touched.

mfa.title: MFA reset policy
steps: Only reset MFA after calling the user back on the number on file, or confirming with their manager.
Never send a code to a new number given during the call.
Log every reset in the ticket with how identity was verified.

phish.title: Phishing runbook
steps: Cut off any account that entered a password: revoke sessions and reset it.
Delete mailbox rules the attacker created.
Block the lookalike link or domain for everyone.
Warn the people who received it through official channels.
Purge the message from inboxes.

token.title: Leaked token runbook
steps: Disabling an account does NOT revoke its tokens. Revoke the leaked token directly.
Rotate every secret the token could read.
Preserve logs and escalate to incident response and legal.
Block the source only after the token is dead.

ransom.title: Ransomware runbook
steps: Isolate infected machines from the network. Don't power them off; memory holds evidence.
Protect backups: disconnect the backup server.
Disable compromised accounts and reset admin passwords.
Restore only after the attacker is out.
Don't pay. Escalate to incident response and legal.
